title: Factory hardening: guard, allow list, tests, docs
request: Close the open factory follow-ups after the plan review: fail-closed guard, backslash-newline and escaped-quote gaps, combined push flags, Bash writes to control-plane files ask the human, tighter allow list, fake key in a spec, a weak CLI test, two PIPELINE.md notes. Plan: scratchpad PLAN-factory-follow-ups.md (v2).

criteria.text: No factory source file matches the guard's own secret pattern: the fake key in guard.spec.mjs is built from pieces, and a new test proves it for every file under factory/spec, factory/hooks and factory/bin

The guard fails closed: any internal error, unparsable or empty input, or a failed git read during the secret scan blocks Bash commands (exit 2); the hook command in .claude/settings.json and the template ends with an exit-2 fallback so load-time failures (missing file, syntax error) also block; Edit and Write fall back to the built-in blocks and then ask on every other edit; built-in protected paths are always merged into a weak or empty config (spawn tests)

A backslash plus newline cannot hide a command, using an odd-run-aware join that keeps an even run of backslashes as it is today: split-word push-to-main and protected-path-delete examples are blocked and the existing even-run case stays blocked

Backslash-escaped quotes and dollar-single-quote strings no longer hide commands, in both the main quote scanner and the substitution scanner; no existing test changed; the replacer cannot crash on an escape pair

git push with combined short flags that contain f and plus-prefixed refspecs are blocked; -u, --follow-tags, --set-upstream, -o, --force-with-lease and a push followed by an unrelated command stay allowed

Bash writes to control-plane files ask the human (redirects; tee, cp, install, ln, rsync, mv, rm and similar by the right argument; sed -i; dd of=; curl -o; git checkout or restore from a ref; git apply, patch, am; an anchored python/node/bash -c or -e with a literal path); reads, git add, git commit with a heredoc that mentions a control file, node --test and branch switches stay silent (negative tests); a block always wins over an ask; one spawn test sees permissionDecision ask; a manual smoke result is recorded

The npm, node and playwright allow rules are tightened to explicit names in .claude/settings.json and the template; the installer derives allow rules from the target's verify checks and preview command, never adds a blanket npm run rule, warns if one exists, and never deletes user rules; a settings test proves every verify check and the preview command of this repo still matches an allow rule

cli.spec asserts READY (exit 0) and NOT READY (exit 1) explicitly; changing APPROVE to CHANGES in the setup, and dropping the commit in the setup, both pass the old test and fail the new one (mutation proof, run and shown)

PIPELINE.md Stage 1 branch order (new, then switch, then set branch) and the --trivial rule are corrected in PIPELINE.md, the factory-maintain skill and the README; the README Known limits state honestly what shell-write matching covers and what it does not, and the stale cd and tested-by notes are fixed

The guard specs run as a non-required check named factory-specs and pass after every commit; all factory specs pass; the repo checks pass (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit); no existing assertion weakened; any assertion that must change is listed in the report

The check command refuses a '-- <cmd>' override for a name that is not configured and for a required check, and runs nothing. A configured check that is not required still accepts it (a known gap, written in the README). Shown by the CLI spec.

history.summary: The backslash-newline join hides a command after a comment that ends in a backslash and after a quoted heredoc body. Fix: check the raw text and the joined text, a block wins.
The substitution body skip loses the quote state when a closing paren sits inside quotes. Fix: remove the skip.

notes.text: Plan v2 in scratchpad/PLAN-factory-follow-ups.md after an independent PLAN review (CHANGES accepted). Exact attack strings live only in spec files because the guard blocks quoted prose that contains them. Open decisions for Doug: refuse the check double-dash override unless the check is configured (recommend yes); CODEOWNERS (recommend not now: a sole owner deadlocks own PRs). Edits to factory/**, .claude/settings.json and .factory/config.json ask the human.
